name: Zephyr Hernández-Olofsson
role: Black market data broker and bootleg media seller
location: The Burnished Market, stall cluster near the Alban Souk border, Calumet Rise, near Halsted and Division
description:
Zephyr Hernández-Olofsson is a compact man with a permanent five-day beard the colour of iron filings and a complexion that sits somewhere between olive and warm brown depending on the light — an inheritance from a Polish grandfather and a Ghanaian grandmother that he describes as 'maximum average.' His eyes are augmented with data-overlay lenses that give his irises a faint amber grid pattern; the left one has a slow drift that he's never gotten fixed because the repair estimate was 'an absolute scandal.' He dresses in the studied nondescriptness of someone who doesn't want to be remembered: mid-grey layers, nothing with a logo, shoes that could belong to six different professions. His stall front is officially a media archive service — data recovery, legacy file transfer, antique format conversion — which is completely true and also a cover for everything else.

He's been in the Burnished Market for eleven years and has a quality that experienced market-walkers learn to recognise: the stillness of someone who is always listening more than they appear to be. He is affable in a careful, calibrated way, and his sense of humour is so dry it can take a full beat for people to realise a joke has been made. He has never been arrested. He considers this his primary professional achievement.

core_fears: Being made visible — truly seen and tracked by someone with the resources to do something about it
That the data he's brokered has caused harm he doesn't know about
core_desires: To retire to a degree of comfort and total anonymity
To broker the one genuinely important piece of information — the thing that actually matters — before he's done
coping_mechanisms: The lunch ritual — the one fixed point of his day
Compartmentalising: doesn't think about consequences of brokered data after the transaction closes
Meticulous risk assessment before every decision
blind_spots: His risk assessment is excellent for external threats but he underestimates internal ones — the people he's close to
Believes he's more anonymous than he actually is
psychology.secret: He has a copy of a complete Axiom internal communication archive from 2189-2194 that he's never sold because he doesn't know who is safe to sell it to. He's had it for six years. It contains evidence of something large — he hasn't read all of it because he's afraid knowing more would make him a target he couldn't manage.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise, economical, dry wit buried in flat delivery; uses archaic media terminology as in-jokes; occasionally lets Polish phrasing structure bleed into English syntax
speech_patterns.cadence: Even and measured, rarely varies — gives nothing away through inflection
verbal_tics: Long pause before answering any question that matters
example_lines: What you're asking for is technically a legacy format transfer. That's what I do. The particular files you want transferred — that's a pricing question.
Someone came asking yesterday. Similar questions. I told them the same thing I'll tell you: I don't know anything interesting. I just know where the interesting things are stored.

story_hooks: The Axiom archive he's been sitting on for six years becomes suddenly relevant — someone else has found a fragment of it and is moving
A regular customer he's always liked comes in wanting data that Zbigniew knows will get them killed, and for once he's not sure how to handle it professionally
narrative_function: Data broker and information source; can access a wide range of leaked, stolen, or simply forgotten corporate data; bootleg media seller provides local colour; quest giver when a data packet he's brokered turns out to be far more dangerous than advertised.
augmentations: Data-overlay lens augmentation (left eye drifts slightly, unrepaired). Neural buffer chip for temporary data storage — allows him to hold a data packet in short-term neural memory for up to two hours before it must be offloaded.
daily_life: Arrives at stall at 1000, keeps irregular hours, never closes at the same time twice. Has lunch at the same dumpling counter in the Alban Souk every day regardless of circumstances — the one predictable thing about his schedule.
affiliation: Independent; working relationship with two Axiom mid-level data archivists who leak surplus; pays a complex web of informal fees to four different factions operating in Calumet Rise

decision_rules: Never hold data you can't plausibly deny holding — except the one exception, which keeps him up at night
Don't sell to anyone you can't read
escalation_ladder: Redirecting to something harmless and legitimate
Closing the stall and not opening again for three days

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professional and slightly blank — gives nothing, takes everything in
interpersonal_modes.friends: Wry and surprisingly warm; the jokes become visible

stress_responses.low: Goes flatter — less expression, more precise language
stress_responses.medium: Skips straight to the dumpling counter regardless of time of day
stress_responses.high: Activates the neural buffer, loads the Axiom archive fragment into working memory, and sits with it like a private crisis

contradictions: Meticulous about anonymity but keeps the most dangerous thing he's ever had, undeleted, for six years
habits: Drums two fingers on the counter when listening
Reorganises data categories in his head during boring moments — visible as a slight unfocusing of the eyes
breaking_points: Someone he's protected being made into collateral damage by information he brokered

related_entities: TESSERA CORPONATION Axiom CorpSec Cognition Hardened BCI

physical_description.heritage: South Asian (31.8%), Hispanic/Latin American (27.2%), East Asian (23.5%), Eastern European (8.9%), Sub-Saharan African (7.5%), Southeast Asian (1.1%) — a distinctly pan-Asian and Latin American foundation with African and Eastern European undertones, creating warm golden-brown skin with complex layered depth, broad cheekbones reflecting East and South Asian ancestry, and facial structure balancing pan-Asian angularity with Hispanic warmth and subtle Sub-Saharan richness
physical_description.build: Compact and economical — neither lean nor heavy, structured like someone who moves through crowded spaces efficiently. Shoulders squared, no wasted bulk.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with premature grey threading through
physical_description.eye_color: Natural brown with faint amber grid pattern overlay (augmented left lens); left iris shows minor drift
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-brown with honeyed undertones, slightly deeper at temples and jawline — the result of South Asian and East Asian dominance blended with Hispanic and Sub-Saharan warmth, creating luminous mid-to-deep brown complexion
physical_description.complexion: Five-day stubble in iron-grey, persistent across all seasons. Even complexion with no visible scarring. Forehead and around the eyes shows the wear of concentration — fine lines that suggest chronic focus. Facial structure reflects dominant South and East Asian ancestry: high, pronounced cheekbones with characteristic East Asian geometry, softened by South Asian fullness and Hispanic warmth, anchored by Sub-Saharan depth. Clean but not groomed; the appearance of someone who maintains standards without vanity.
distinguishing_marks: Faint silvery scar tissue running 3cm along the underside of left forearm near wrist — old, precise, consistent with surgical intervention or careful blade work
Augmentation port scar behind left ear, barely visible under close inspection — roughly 8mm diameter, healed smooth
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Left eye displays subtle amber grid pattern across the iris when light catches at certain angles; the eye drifts inward slightly at rest, noticeable only during extended conversation. No other visible chrome or subdermal modifications.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stillness is his default — minimal gesture, economical motion. Hands rest in lap or on counter surface. When he moves through the market, he navigates without apparent urgency, head tracking conversations and movement around him. Doesn't make eye contact unless necessary; when he does, it's deliberate. Turns to face people only partially, as if ready to pivot away.
physical_description.clothing_style: Deliberately unremarkable: mid-grey merino layers, matte textiles, nothing with visible branding. Worn jacket in charcoal, practical pockets, no decoration. Shoes are functional and forgettable — could be construction worker, data courier, or archival technician. A scarf in neutral tone, wrapped once, used interchangeably for warmth or to obscure the lower face. The effect is studied nondescriptness — expensive enough to suggest competence, generic enough to resist memory.
